title: NBD: Update dissector
description:
Update dissector based on documentation and capturing on the loopback
interface from running make check.

Type fields are two bytes; the preceding two bytes are flags.
Dissect flags.
Add additional types.
Add structured reply type.

There's an IANA assigned TCP port, but the heuristics are still
used in all cases currently because the initial handshake isn't
handled yet.

Ping #13034
